GitHub Issue: Post Date: 2018-05-21T10:52:01Z Current Date: April 4 2025 Title: Ocelot on full .Net framework 4.6.1 fails to create HttpClient and use Description: ## Steps to Reproduce the Problem In VS 2017 create .Net Core project but select (at the second screen) .NET Framework, not .Net Core one. Select in the Project -> properties 4.6.1 framework. Configure Ocelot and run. An attempt to get into a route will throw. ## Specifications - Version: Win 10 - Platform: .NET 4.6.1 - Subsystem: And here is the code to fix it:

             }

+            HttpClientHandler httpclientHandler;
